verdict.rationale: Aleph ships an AI agent that pulls data from connected systems, so letting users plug in MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence mentions MCP client support or registering external MCP servers. Its 150+ connectors and API integrations are a related but different feature and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
